{{nihongo|'''Iwashizu Shrine'''|伊和志津神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

'''Iwashizu Shrine''' (いわしづじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}, {{ill|Takarazuka, Hyōgo|Q823967|qid=Q823967}}, {{ill|Isoji|Q11379317|qid=Q11379317}}. It is a Shikinaisha Grand Shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} (a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=ronsha}}). It is also written as “'''Iwashizu Shrine'''.”

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}
:He is the {{ill|Ubusunagami|Q1392097|qid=Q1392097}} (ujigami) of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Isoji Village}} (いそしむら) in {{ill|Settsu Province|Q864163|qid=Q864163}}, {{ill|Muko district|Q11545988|qid=Q11545988}}. It is believed that the ancestral deity of the Isoji no Omi clan was originally enshrined here.

=== History ===
Because it was already listed as a grand shrine in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, the shrine must have been founded no later than the 9th century. However, the surrounding area had been a base of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Isoji}}{{ill|Omi (title)|be|Омі (тытул)|ff|Omi (title)|fr|Omi (titre de noblesse)|it|Omi|ja|臣|pt|Omi (título)|ru|Оми (титул)|simple|Omi (title)|uk|Омі (титул)|uz|Omi|zh|臣 (姓)|qid=Q2574718}} clan since the latter half of the 8th century{{refnest|group=Notes|According to the {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362}} and the {{ill|Shoku Nihongi|Q611399|qid=Q611399}}, the lineage runs: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Magotenomichi-ne no Mikoto}} → {{ill|Narahara|de|Narahara|ja|楢原|ko|나라하라|qid=Q92770386}} → {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Isoji}} → {{ill|Shigeno clan|ja|滋野氏|qid=Q11564992}}, sharing a common ancestor with the {{ill|Kii no Kuni no Miyatsuko|fr|Kii no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|紀伊国造|simple|Kii no Kuni no Miyatsuko|qid=Q11604953}}.}}, and it is possible that the Isoji no Omi founded the shrine during this period. There is also an “Iwashizu Shrine” of the same disputed ranking as a subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Hirota Shrine (Osaka City)|de|Hirota-Schrein|es|Santuario Hirota|eu|Hirota santutegia|fr|Hirota-jinja|id|Kuil Hirota|it|Santuario di Hirota|ja|廣田神社|ru|Хирота-дзиндзя|zh|廣田神社|qid=Q1466105}} ({{ill|Nishinomiya|ar|نيشينومايا (هيوغو)|arz|نيشينومايا, هيوجو|az|Nişinomiya|azb|نیشی‌نومیا، هیوقو|be|Нісіномія|bg|Нишиномия|ca|Nishinomiya|ce|Нисиномия|ceb|Nishinomiya Shi|ckb|نیشینۆمیا|cs|Nišinomija (Hjógo)|de|Nishinomiya|eo|Niŝinomija|es|Nishinomiya|et|Nishinomiya|eu|Nishinomiya (Hyōgo)|fa|نیشی‌نومیا، هیوگو|fi|Nishinomiya|fr|Nishinomiya|ga|Nishinomiya|gl|Nishinomiya|id|Nishinomiya, Hyōgo|it|Nishinomiya|ja|西宮市|ko|니시노미야시|lb|Nishinomiya|lg|Nishinomiya|mdf|Нисиномия|mzn|نیشی‌نومیا، هیوگو|nl|Nishinomiya|no|Nishinomiya|pl|Nishinomiya|pt|Nishinomiya|ro|Nishinomiya|ru|Нисиномия|sco|Nishinomiya|sh|Nishinomija|simple|Nishinomiya, Hyōgo|sr|Нишиномија|sv|Nishinomiya|szl|Nishinomiya|tg|Нишиномия|th|นิชิโนมิยะ|tl|Nishinomiya|tr|Nishinomiya|tt|Нисиномия|tum|Nishinomiya|uk|Нісіномія|ur|نیشیمومیا, ہیوگو|uz|Nishinomiya|vi|Nishinomiya|war|Nishinomiya|zh|西宮市|zh_classical|西宮市|zh_min_nan|Nisinomiya-chhī|zh_yue|西宮|qid=Q243853}}).

=== Shrine grounds ===
* Main hall – A one-bay shrine in {{ill|Kasuga-zukuri|Q3193781|qid=Q3193781}} style with {{ill|Wood shingle|Q199388|qid=Q199388}}, believed to date from the mid-{{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}.
* In 1995, as part of a project to straighten {{ill|Hyogo Prefectural Road Route 337|Q11393353|qid=Q11393353|lt=prefectural road}} that bypasses the shrine, the intersecting approach road was converted into a grade-separated crossing, and buildings such as the worship hall were newly constructed.
* Atago Shrine
* Takarazuka Suitengū

=== Festivals ===
* April 23–24 – Spring Festival
* June 30 – Great Purification
* July 27–28 – Summer Festival
* August 24 – Atago Festival
* October 23–24 – Autumn Grand Festival
* December 15 – Fire Kindling Festival

=== Cultural properties ===
; Designated cultural properties of Takarazuka City
* Main hall
; Designated preserved forest of Takarazuka City
* Iwashizu Shrine precincts – approximately 3,000 tsubo

=== Access ===
* 6-minute walk from {{ill|Hankyū Imazu Line|Q3832688|qid=Q3832688}} {{ill|Sakasegawa Station|Q7402849|qid=Q7402849}}
